summary: Contract terms can record an escalation ceiling (cap_pct: 'not to exceed X%') and the contract year escalation begins in; Canyon Gate's United Protective Services and Gate Sentry contracts corrected from their quoted clauses. No budget, GL, invoice or payment changes.

preflight.name: UPS contract still reads 'greater of CPI or 3%'
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_contracts WHERE id = '96321a51-d765-4fe2-ae37-adcfbd87f39a' AND escalator_kind = 'max_cpi_or_pct' AND escalator_pct = 3

preflight.name: Gate Sentry contract is fixed 5%
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_contracts WHERE id = '506222f2-dd38-4708-ba45-856f64b3b29d' AND escalator_kind = 'fixed_pct' AND escalator_pct = 5

preflight.name: escalator_start_year does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'vendor_contracts' AND column_name = 'escalator_start_year'

expected_changes: vendor_contracts: escalator_kind may be 'cap_pct'; new column escalator_start_year (>= 2).
United Protective Services: escalator 'max_cpi_or_pct' 3 -> 'cap_pct' 3, with a note.
Gate Sentry: escalator_start_year 4, with a note.

verify.name: UPS escalator is a 3% ceiling
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_contracts WHERE id = '96321a51-d765-4fe2-ae37-adcfbd87f39a' AND escalator_kind = 'cap_pct' AND escalator_pct = 3

verify.name: Gate Sentry escalation starts in year 4
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_contracts WHERE id = '506222f2-dd38-4708-ba45-856f64b3b29d' AND escalator_start_year = 4

verify.name: no other contract changed escalator kind to cap_pct
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_contracts WHERE escalator_kind = 'cap_pct'
